tha-ap52:1.1: Cunda.] Siddhatthassa bhagavato lokajeṭṭhassa tādino / agghiyaṃ kārayitvāna jātipupphehi chādayiṃ. // //
tha-ap52:2.1: Niṭṭhapetvāna taṃ puppham buddhassa upanāmayiṃ / pupphāvasesaṃ paggayha Buddhassa abhiropayiṃ. // //
tha-ap52:3.1: Kañcanagghiyasaṅkāsaṃ Buddhaṃ lokagganāyakaṃ / pasannacitto sumano pupphagghiyam upānayiṃ. // //
tha-ap52:4.1: Vitiṇṇakaṅkho sambuddho tiṇṇoghehi purakkhato / bhikkhusaṅghe nisīditvā imā gāthā abhāsatha: // //
tha-ap52:5.1: Dibbaṃ gandhaṃ pavāyantaṃ yo me pupphagghiyaṃ adā / tam ahaṃ kittayissāmi; suṇotha mama bhāsato: // //
tha-ap52:6.1: Ito cuto ayaṃ poso devasaṅghapurakkhato / jātipupphehi parikiṇṇo devalokaṃ gamissati. // //
tha-ap52:7.1: Ubbiddhaṃ bhavanaṃ tassa sovaṇṇañ ca maṇimayaṃ / vyamhā pātubhavissanti puññakammapabhāvitā. // // Catusattatikkhattuṃ
tha-ap52:8.1: so devarajjaṃ karissati / anubhossati sampattiṃ accharāhi purakkhato. // //
tha-ap52:9.1: *Pathavyā rajjaṃ tisataṃ vasudhaṃ* āvasissati / pañcasattatikkhattuñ ca cakkavattī bhavissati. // //
tha-ap52:10.1: Dujjayo nāma nāmena hessati manujādhipo / anubhotvāna taṃ puññaṃ sakakammaṃ apassito. // //
tha-ap52:11.1: Vinipātaṃ āgantvāna manussattaṃ gamissati / *hiraññassa ca nicitaṃ koṭṭisatān* anappakaṃ. // //
tha-ap52:12.1: Nibbattissati lokamhi brāhmaṇo so bhavissati / Vaṅgantassa suto dhīmā Sāriyā oraso piyo. // //
tha-ap52:13.1: So ca pacchā pabbājitvā Aṅgīrasassa sāsane / Cūlacundo ti nāmena hessati *satthu sāvako. // //
tha-ap52:14.1: Sāmaṇero ca* so santo khīṇāsavo bhavissati / sabbāsave pariññāya nibbayissat' anāsavo. // //
tha-ap52:15.1: Upaṭṭhahiṃ mahāvīraṃ aññe ca pesale bahū / bhātaram me c' upaṭṭhāsiṃ uttamatthassa pattiyā. // //
tha-ap52:16.1: Bhā*taraṃ me upaṭṭhitvā dhātū pattamhi* opiya / sambuddhaṃ upanāmesi lokajeṭṭhaṃ narāsabhaṃ. // //
tha-ap52:17.1: Ubho hatthehi paggayha Buddho loke sadevake / sandassayanto taṃ dhātuṃ kittayi aggasāvakaṃ. // //
tha-ap52:18.1: Cittañ ca suvimu*ttaṃ me saddhā mayhaṃ patiṭṭhitā / sabbāsa*ve pariññāya viharāmi anāsavo. // //
tha-ap52:19.1: Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh' ime / chaḷabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan
tha-ap52:20.1: ti. // // Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Cundathero imā gāthāyo abhā- sitthā ti.
tha-ap52:24.1: Upāli Soṇo Bhaddiyo Sannidhāpaka Hatthiyo Chadanaṃ Seyya-Caṅkamaṃ Subhaddo Cundasavhayo gāthā satañ ca tālīsaṃ catasso ca tath' uttari
